Define the term 'Hypertext' in the context of the World Wide Web. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Hypertext is text displayed on a computer screen that contains dynamic hyperlinks, allowing users to instantly navigate to other related web documents or resources.

questions.question_text: What is the primary function of a 'Web Browser' software? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A web browser is an application software used to access, retrieve, and visually render HTML documents and multimedia content from web servers across the Internet.

questions.question_text: Differentiate between an Internal CSS style sheet and an External CSS style sheet. [25-35 words]
questions.answer: Internal CSS applies styling rules within the <style> tag of a single HTML document's head section. External CSS stores rules in a separate .css file linked to multiple HTML pages, promoting consistent site-wide design.

questions.question_text: Identify the purpose of the <form> tag's 'action' attribute. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The 'action' attribute specifies the exact URL or script destination where the collected form data should be sent for server-side processing upon submission.

questions.question_text: Explain the role of a 'Gateway' device in computer networking. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A gateway acts as a critical network node that connects two fundamentally different networks, translating communication protocols so data can pass seamlessly between them.

sections.section_name: Section C - Short Answer Application Problems

questions.question_text: Write out the complete HTML advanced elements code layout needed to create a drop-down selection form containing three country choices. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The syntax requires using the <select> tag wrapped around individual choice items: <select name='country'><option>India</option><option>Japan</option><option>Canada</option></select>.

questions.question_text: Provide the precise CSS rule-set to target all <h1> heading tags and change their text color to blue and alignment to center. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: To format the headings, apply the following CSS block within your stylesheet or style tag: h1 { color: blue; text-align: center; } This efficiently overrides default browser styling for all level-one headings.

questions.question_text: Write the exact HTML syntax to construct a data table comprising two rows and two columns. The first row must contain table headers 'Name' and 'Age', and the second row must contain table data 'Rahul' and '15'. Include a 1-pixel border. [50-60 words]
questions.answer:
The required table layout code is:
NameAge
Rahul15
. This markup utilizes the table tag for structure, tr tags to define horizontal rows, th tags for bold centralized headers, and td tags for standard cell data insertion.

questions.question_text: A student attempts to link an external CSS file named 'styles.css' to their HTML document using the code <a href='styles.css'>. Identify why this fails, explain the technical difference between hyperlink tags and metadata link tags, and provide the correct HTML code to resolve the error. [60-70 words]
questions.answer: The <a> tag creates clickable hyperlinks for users to navigate to other pages, it does not import stylesheet rules. To attach external CSS, the student must use the empty <link> element placed within the document's <head> section. The correct, functional syntax is: <link rel='stylesheet' type='text/css' href='styles.css'>. This informs the browser to fetch and apply the styling instructions automatically.
